A parallel review opened #6701 for the same defect before this PR became visible. #6701 is the active fix. The independent verification and review spans are recorded below.

## Defect

SecureNow builds edge cut-point keys from two path endpoints and an edge type. Each endpoint can fit its own SQL column while their combined key exceeds the 768-code-unit cut-point column, rolling back the snapshot's cut-point refresh. Use a stable SHA-256 key for oversized values at the persistence mapping boundary. The original endpoints, analysis ordering, and shorter keys are preserved.

## Validation

The source and schema width probe failed on master with an 811-code-unit key and passed after the patch with a 71-character persisted key. It checked stability, distinct long keys, and the unchanged 768-code-unit boundary. git diff --check passed. Added two C# regressions. Local .NET execution and live SQL were unavailable.

## Review evidence

Nov. 16, 2026, 8:32–8:34 p.m. ET. Master baseline c21b578f95fa131db853346d0911a45621098067. One distinct confirmed defect in 236 unique nonblank lines across path analysis, identifier mapping, SQL persistence and schema.

Reviewed spans: ArchLucid.Application/InfraEvidence/SecureNowArchitect/SecurityEvidenceCutPointAnalyzer.cs 74–234; ArchLucid.Application/InfraEvidence/SecureNowArchitect/CapabilityToFlowEnumerator.cs 20–44; ArchLucid.Persistence/Migrations/381_SecurityEvidencePaths.sql 41–59; ArchLucid.Persistence/Migrations/383_SecurityEvidenceCutPoints.sql 10–33; ArchLucid.Persistence/InfraEvidence/SqlSecurityEvidenceCutPointRepository.cs 296–328.

## Application defect

The hosted operational-error drain used the audit retry helper's normal return as evidence of a successful append. The helper also returns normally after it exhausts retries, so a failing record disappeared from the pending queue. Acknowledge the record only when the repository append returns successfully, and send exhausted attempts through the worker's existing requeue path.

## Validation

- Reproduced on master with three simulated append failures and a pending count of zero.
- Two focused Release tests passed with warnings treated as errors. The new regression uses the actual hosted drain and queue and verifies that the same record is persisted on the fourth append attempt.
- git diff --check passed. Live SQL outage recovery was outside the test scope. Capacity rejection reporting is covered separately by #6638.

## Review sample

Nov. 16, 2026, 9:57–9:58 and 10:21–10:23 a.m. ET on master e810c405. One distinct confirmed application defect in 183 unique nonblank application-source lines, or 5.46 per 1,000. This is the same defect documented in the earlier aggregate. Scope covers the hosted drain, core retry helper, and persistence port.

Reviewed spans: OperationalErrorCaptureDrainHostedService.cs 1–67, DurableAuditLogRetry.cs 1–133, and IOperationalErrorRepository.cs 1–15.
